## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and [FEATURES.md](../FEATURES.md) are updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] A change to a user-visible string says how many catalogue keys it adds or removes.
- [ ] A decision that shapes the architecture carries an ADR under [`docs/adr/`](../docs/adr/README.md).
